tool.name: Biomni: Query Iucn
tool.description: Query the IUCN Red List API using natural language or a direct endpoint.
tool.help:
**Biomni: Query Iucn**
Query the IUCN Red List API using natural language or a direct endpoint.
Parameters ---------- prompt (str, required): Natural language query about species conservation status endpoint (str, optional): API endpoint name (e.g., "species/id/12392") or full URL token (str): IUCN API token - required for all queries verbose (bool): Whether to print verbose output
Returns ------- dict: Dictionary containing the query results or error information
Examples -------- - Natural language: query_iucn("Get conservation status of white rhinoceros", token="your-token") - Direct endpoint: query_iucn(endpoint="species/id/12392", token="your-token")
**Domain**: database **Function**: query_iucn
